names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14283, «Алексий (Дроздов), протодиакон, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname — «Сщмч. Алексия диакона (1942).» `fk.mjs` returns no holder for the form and none for the display name; the bare «Алексий» was deliberately not stored, the corpus keeping a great many of that name.

death.note: The year the day line prints for him: «Сщмч. Алексия диакона (1942).» Neither page gives a year of birth and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алексия диакона (1942).»

attestations.note: The day’s sixth and last entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to his name and to no reading, and name page 14283 prints the title, «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 1 июля», and nothing else. What the name page adds over the day line is the surname «Дроздов» and the grade «протодиакон», protodeacon, where the day line says «диакона»; `office` is the name page’s word, which the four locale packs carry, and `deacon` is in `types` off the day line. `new-martyr` was written on the ground that both his pages mark him a martyr and set the 26 января synaxis of the new martyrs beside his own day. The 26 января page was NOT read. No folder was found for him. azbyka.ru was not read.
